notes: R1-2 (fix round after the four-role tests, decisions A19 and A22): the corrected down-regulation order of the default PSM compares the restart cost of gas and biomass units with the short-run cost their reduction avoids, instead of always reducing thermal output before VRE (the P0-6 S7 reading of P3-03, withdrawn by A19). A method change of the corrected profile only (Q13: saved Studies need explicit confirmation); the doctoral reproduction profile keeps the thesis curtail-cost order (Q1).

The switch is one field of NativeMarketRules (gridform_core/builtin/scheme_c_1000twh/native_market_rules.py FIELD_CORRECTIONS, downward_restart_economics); the restart values are gridform_core/data/thermal/value_thermal_restart_v1.json (reference statistics section 4, author-reviewed in A22).

advisory.title: Down regulation without restart economics
advisory.summary: This Run's default PSM ordered down regulation without restart costs: the thesis rule reduces output in ascending curtail cost (VRE first), and the corrected rule before A19 always reduced gas and biomass output before VRE. Since A19/A22 the corrected profile reduces gas and biomass before VRE only down to minimum stable generation; shutting units down below it comes before curtailing VRE only when the fuel, carbon and variable cost avoided over the expected downtime exceeds the restart cost.

deviation_signature.doctoral: down regulation in ascending curtail_cost (P3-03 thesis order); no restart cost, minimum stable generation or expected downtime

corrections.description: Economic down-regulation stack of the curtailment branch. A gas (CCGT, OCGT) or biomass row is split at min_stable_fraction x its accepted day-ahead output (its online capacity): the running range above it is reduced at its avoided cost c = gen_cost (fuel + carbon + unit_time_cost), before VRE; the shutdown segment below it (down to the ramp floor) has net saving a(H) = c - S(H)/(m H) per MWh of output removed, where m is the minimum stable fraction and S is the restart cost per MW of capacity (CCGT 110/130/150 hot/warm/cold by H, OCGT 170, biomass 125 GBP/MW) and H = (1 + consecutive later periods whose day-ahead forecast is in surplus, forecast demand <= forecast VRE + nuclear availability) x 0.5 h. It is reduced before VRE when a > 0 (descending a), after VRE when a <= 0, and only as a last resort when H is below the minimum down time (CCGT 6 h, OCGT 0.5 h, biomass 6 h). VRE, imports, hydro and nuclear keep the P3-03 avoided-cost keys; ties are broken by class rank, asset name and input order. Restart costs rank the stack only; the cost accounts are unchanged.
